basis: Brain disease, cleft palate (3/5) and clubfeet (30-79%) characterize the syndrome; small nails lack demonstrated functional injury; cardiac frequency unclear; lung hypoplasia 2/7.

decisions.dermatologic: none: small nails occur in 30-79%, but isolated nail hypoplasia does not establish functionally damaging skin or nail disease.

basis: Slow-channel acetylcholine receptor dysfunction causes impaired neuromuscular transmission and characteristic degenerative endplate myopathy; respiratory weakness does not establish lung injury.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: prolonged receptor opening causes characteristic degenerative endplate myopathy, establishing intrinsic skeletal muscle injury.

basis: Persistent visual impairment and abnormal visual cortical development are explicit in the supplied definition; optic nerve disease belongs to the ocular axis.

decisions.neurologic: primary: the supplied definition explicitly identifies abnormal visual cortical development, establishing a neurodevelopmental site.

basis: Inherited marrow failure; developmental delay reported in 20/20; structural limb anomalies affect approximately 35% in usual Fanconi anemia, with limited FANCE-specific frequency data.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: functionally significant radial/thumb malformations affect approximately 35% in usual Fanconi anemia; subtype-specific frequency remains uncertain.

basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment defines the syndrome; neurofibromas and toenail dysplasia are annotated 30-79%; simple toe syndactyly does not establish locomotor injury.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: frequent 2-3 toe syndactyly is a minor structural variant without demonstrated functional impairment; large hands alone add no axis.

basis: Site-unspecified carcinoma histology spanning different organs, including breast and penis; the record establishes no shared organ axis.

decisions.dermatologic: none: squamous differentiation does not establish cutaneous origin; neither the definition nor the listed subtypes establishes skin involvement.

basis: Encephalopathy and optic atrophy define PEHO; syndromic gingival overgrowth is annotated 30-79%; contractures do not establish direct muscle or joint disease.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: persistent gingival overgrowth is a recognized syndromic phenotype annotated at 30-79%; gingiva belongs to this axis.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: contractures and restricted mobility occur in 30-79%, but reflect severe neurologic impairment without established direct muscle or joint pathology.

basis: Inherited phosphate dysregulation causes rickets and intrinsic dentin hypomineralization in over 30%; renal phosphate wasting alone does not establish kidney injury.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: intrinsic dentin mineralization defects affect over 30% and directly compromise teeth; this does not rely on separately diagnosed dental abscesses.

basis: Congenital limb contractures and ocular dysfunction define DA5; restrictive ventilation in 3/3 reflects thoracic mechanical restriction without established direct lung or airway injury.

decisions.pulmonary: none: restrictive ventilation is documented in 3/3, but chest-wall restriction does not establish direct pulmonary tissue or airway disease.

basis: Demyelinating sensorimotor neuropathy; pes cavus (1/2) and distal amyotrophy are consequences of denervation, without established direct skeletal or muscle pathology.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: pes cavus (1/2) and muscle wasting result from neuropathic denervation; the record does not establish direct muscle, bone or joint disease.
